DrawUp Swap

Same space. New vybe.

Upload your room, render or design image, then change the finishes — free to start, credits power generations.

  • Court paint → Light blue + orange
  • Wood → Terrazzo
  • White wall → Deep blue
  • Standard lighting → Linear LED

Same geometry, same angle, same upload — Swap only changes the material. This DrawUp Athletic Center court is the same render shown in the hologram; here it's re-painted from navy to DrawUp's own light blue + orange.

Q + A

What is DrawUp?

Quick answers about the platform, Arch Coach, DrawUp Check, privacy, credits and what DrawUp is — and is not.

What does DrawUp do?

DrawUp is an AEC assistance platform for discovering precedents and firms, learning, organizing project knowledge, reviewing work, exploring details and getting AI-assisted guidance through Arch Coach.

Is Arch Coach a licensed architect or engineer?

No. Arch Coach is an AI assistance tool. It can help explain, organize, review and suggest paths to investigate, but it does not replace the judgment, services or seal of a licensed professional.

Does DrawUp make drawings permit-ready?

No. DrawUp does not certify, stamp, seal, approve or guarantee drawings as permit-ready, code-compliant or construction-ready. The responsible design team and applicable licensed professionals make final determinations.

Who makes the final design decision?

You do. DrawUp can provide observations, options and recommendations, but design authorship and final aesthetic, technical and project decisions remain with the user and responsible design professionals.

Are my AEC Arch Coach conversations private?

DrawUp is designed so your private project conversations are not publicly visible to other users. Access and handling remain subject to the Privacy Policy, security controls, legal requirements and service providers needed to operate the platform.

What are Arch Coach credits?

Credits meter AI usage by workload. Visitors receive 10 guest questions; signed-up Explore accounts receive 50 credits. Basic questions generally use 2–5 credits, code/ADA questions 5–10, and heavier plan, detail, compliance, rendering and document workflows use more. DrawUp displays estimated usage before heavier actions.

Can I cancel a paid subscription?

Yes. You may cancel at any time. Unless otherwise required by law or stated at purchase, cancellation stops renewal and access continues through the end of the already-paid billing period.

Legal · Grooveville LLC

Privacy Policy

How DrawUp handles account, project and AEC-assistance information.

Effective October 2, 2026
DrawUp is operated by Grooveville LLC. This page is a product policy and should be reviewed by qualified counsel before commercial launch.

Your work is not a public search feed.

Private Arch Coach threads and private project content are not made visible to other DrawUp users merely because you use the service. We use information as reasonably necessary to provide, secure, maintain, troubleshoot and improve the service, comply with law, and enforce our policies. We do not represent private AEC prompts as public community content unless you intentionally publish or share them.

Information we may process

Account and profile information, firm or university affiliation, subscription and transaction records, prompts, conversations, uploaded AEC files, product usage, device/security data, support communications and content you intentionally make public.

AI and service providers

To provide AI-assisted features, relevant prompts, files and context may be processed by contracted infrastructure and AI service providers under their applicable terms and our configuration. Do not submit information you are not authorized to share.

Safety and legal requests

DrawUp may preserve, review, restrict or disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with applicable law, valid legal process, protect rights or safety, investigate abuse, or respond to credible threats. We do not promise automatic reporting to an employer, university or law-enforcement agency for every flagged query; any disclosure is subject to applicable law, context and our safety procedures.

Security and retention

We use reasonable administrative, technical and organizational safeguards, but no system can guarantee absolute security. Information may be retained as needed to operate the service, maintain records, resolve disputes, prevent abuse and meet legal obligations.

Your choices

You may manage your account, cancel subscriptions, and request available privacy/account actions through DrawUp support, subject to legal, security and record-retention requirements.

Terms of Service

Terms for using DrawUp, subscriptions, credits and AEC assistance.

Effective October 2, 2026

Agreement

DrawUp is a product of Grooveville LLC. By creating an account, purchasing a subscription or using DrawUp, you agree to these Terms and incorporated policies.

Subscriptions and billing

Paid subscriptions renew for the billing period shown at checkout unless canceled. You may cancel at any time. Unless otherwise required by law or expressly stated at purchase, cancellation prevents the next renewal and your paid access continues through the end of the current paid period. Fees already charged are non-refundable except where required by law or expressly stated by DrawUp. Taxes may apply. Prices, plan features and credit allowances may change prospectively with notice as required by law.

Credits

AI credits are usage units, not cash, stored value or transferable currency. Monthly credits may reset according to the plan shown at purchase. Purchased top-up credits are governed by the terms shown when purchased. DrawUp may use different credit amounts for computationally heavier features and will display applicable usage where practicable.

Your responsibility

You are responsible for your account, inputs, project decisions, professional obligations, licenses, contracts, deliverables and use of DrawUp outputs. You must have rights to upload and process submitted content.

No professional engagement

Using DrawUp does not create an architect-client, engineer-client, attorney-client, consultant-client, fiduciary or other licensed professional relationship with Grooveville LLC.

Acceptable use

Do not use DrawUp to violate law, infringe rights, compromise systems, expose confidential information without authorization, or facilitate harmful or violent wrongdoing. DrawUp may suspend or terminate access, preserve evidence, and make disclosures where permitted or required by law.

Service availability

Features may change, improve, pause or be discontinued. Beta, preseason, AI and experimental features may produce incomplete or incorrect results. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided without guarantees of uninterrupted availability or error-free output.

Limitation

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Grooveville LLC is not responsible for professional decisions, permitting outcomes, code determinations, construction results, RFIs, change orders, delays, redesign, rework, lost profits or other project consequences arising from reliance on DrawUp guidance. Mandatory rights that cannot legally be excluded remain unaffected.

AI Policy

How to use Arch Coach and other AI-assisted DrawUp features responsibly.

AI assists. People decide.

DrawUp AI can summarize, brainstorm, organize, critique, identify issues for further review and suggest resources or next steps. AI can be incomplete, outdated, incorrect or unsuitable for a particular jurisdiction or project.

Professional verification

Verify material information against current project documents, adopted codes, authority-having-jurisdiction requirements, manufacturer information and qualified licensed professionals. Never treat an AI response as a seal, certification, permit approval or final professional determination.

Design ownership and judgment

Designers and responsible professionals retain final judgment over design intent, aesthetics, technical decisions and issued work. DrawUp opinions and recommendations are assistance, not commands.

Private AEC use

Private AEC conversations are not displayed to other users as public searches. Content may still be processed to provide and secure the service as described in the Privacy Policy.

Misuse and safety

DrawUp may restrict unsafe or prohibited uses. Credible threats, unlawful conduct or legally reportable matters may be preserved or disclosed when permitted or required by law. We do not promise automatic reporting to a user's firm or university.

Legal · Grooveville LLC

Professional Disclaimer

DrawUp is guidance and assistance — not professional sign-off.

Always verify with the responsible licensed professional.

DrawUp and Arch Coach are AEC assistance tools operated by Grooveville LLC. They are not licensed architects, engineers, interior-design professionals, code officials, contractors, attorneys or authorities having jurisdiction.

Not “permit ready”

Even when DrawUp performs a thorough review, we do not claim that drawings, specifications, models, details or other outputs are permit-ready, code-compliant, bid-ready or construction-ready. Review by the appropriate licensed professional and applicable authority remains required.

You get the final say

Design is ultimately yours. DrawUp may offer observations, alternatives and opinions, but the user and responsible design team retain final control over what a design looks like and how a project is documented.

RFIs and project consequences

DrawUp guidance does not transfer professional responsibility to Grooveville LLC. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Grooveville LLC does not assume responsibility for RFIs, submittal comments, permit comments, coordination conflicts, omissions, change orders, redesign, rework, delays, costs or other project outcomes resulting from professional or project decisions. Users must independently review and coordinate project information.

No seal or professional relationship

DrawUp does not stamp or seal documents and use of the platform does not create a licensed professional-client relationship with Grooveville LLC.
